title: movingWindowMedian request
description: Rolling windows of days as blocks that do not overlap, one point per window, on a relative time axis that ends at the last complete day. The median is a dot inside a wide rounded bar from P25 to P75 (linear interpolation, like PERCENTILE_CONT in BigQuery). The caller sends raw daily values; the service computes periods, statistics, axes and labels.

metric.description: Identifier of the metric, e.g. creditLeads. Used as title when no title is given.

title.description: Title above the chart. States what is shown, not a conclusion.

measureType.description: Kind of number. Required until Domain Hub or the dbt YAML supplies it.

uniqueAggregation.description: Required for unique counts: daily shows the daily uniques; overPeriod (unique over the whole period) cannot be derived from daily values.

window.description: Length of the rolling window in days: 1 for the daily values, or a multiple of 7 (another length is a tolerated deviation).

horizon.description: Number of windows (points) on the relative axis, the last one ending at the last complete day.

spread.description: Spread around the median: iqr (the chart language default) or none.

values.description: Which values are written on the chart: off, last (the last value), lastAndPrevious (the last final value in bold, a running one next to it in grey) or all (only with few points; otherwise the default is used).

valueAxis.description: zero: the value axis starts at zero. zoom: it may start at a round value just below the data, marked with a zigzag at the start of the baseline and a bold first value; allowed for positions such as averages and medians.

format.description: Output format. Only svg is available in v0.

locale.description: Language of titles, labels and messages, e.g. en or nl-BE. Unknown locales fall back to English.

context.description: Provenance and status for the footer. Missing values are shown as unknown.

data.description: Daily values. 0 is a measured zero; null or an absent day means no data. Send zeros explicitly.
